description: This file is a PHP class that functions as a controller for Anti-Spam features within the OpenCart admin panel. It manages listing, filtering, adding, editing, and deleting anti-spam keywords, handling routing, permissions, and rendering views.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: Controller class for managing anti-spam keywords within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main anti-spam list view, setting up breadcrumbs, filters, and loading necessary view components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of anti-spam entries, primarily calling getList().

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of anti-spam entries based on filters and pagination, returning the rendered view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an anti-spam keyword.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or edited anti-spam keyword, including permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected anti-spam keywords, with permission validation.
